notes.title: Cast Out Colony launches into Full Release on March 3rd!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here with BIIIIIIIG news!

🎉 CAST OUT COLONY WILL LAUNCH INTO V1.0 ON MARCH 3RD! 🎉

V1.0 brings:

1 NEW Character
3 NEW Skills
4 NEW Mystic Skills
1 NEW Arena
1 NEW Pick-Up Item
1 NEW Enemy Type
1 NEW Stat
Gameplay Balances, Changes, and Fixes
UI Updates


We've also changed how the colony, weapons, and buildings are saved to significantly improve saving/loading times and reduce file size. As a result, all Early Access colonies, weapons, and buildings will be reset. However, your other stats remain intact. In our playtests, it only took a few runs to re-unlock everything we previously had. We’re very sorry for this inconvenience, but the end result is a much smoother experience.

Lastly, as mentioned in the EOY update, Cast Out Colony will receive a slight price increase. In the US, the game will go from $8.99 to $9.99. (Price may vary based on your region) However, it will be on sale during the week of March 3rd to celebrate the launch!

Thank you to everyone who has been along for the ride! I hope you all enjoy the new additions and changes to Cast Out Colony!

notes.title: End of the Year Update!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here! Hope you all got to enjoy the holiday season and are looking forward to ushering in a brand spankin’ new year! 

The team and I thought it would be a good idea to give you all an “End of the Year” update on everything that has happened over the past few months and a glimpse of what is coming to Cast Out Colony in 2025! Let’s get to it, shall we?


The past few months
Back in September we let the community voice for the next character that will be joining the game in the full release of Cast Out Colony. Across all socials, discord, steam comments, etc., the winner and newest addition to the playable roster is…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/0a73708e41a5b543e5c2ee096506bc124447965c.png
Buck & Wild!

It ended up being a close race between Mosquiteer and Buck & Wild, but the duo pulled off the victory. I hope you all enjoy playing as them, whether you voted for or against the cowbug and his noble steed!

We’ve had them in the game internally since the end of October and they made their first public appearance at GDEX 2025, a game development convention in Columbus, Ohio. Some of you with dragonfly eyes might have noticed we updated the trailer with new footage of Buck & Wild around that time. We got to use the event as playtesting for the new character (they were quite a popular pick) and players really enjoyed the character’s overall play style. If you are reading this and you were at the convention, thank you so much for stopping by, playing the game, chatting with us, and showing your support! Oh, and since we are talking about GDEX…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/5e78c8fbb077c9dff40c157240135f02b84707e3.png
WE WON A FREAKIN’ AWARD!

Although there were TONS of awesome games on display, we were honored to receive the Best in Show - Unreleased Game! This award means a lot to the team not only as a reflection of hard work paying off, but it also comes from our hometown! We love being a part of the Columbus game dev scene, and hope to continue to contribute for years to come! 

On to 2025
We have spent the past few months polishing up Cast Out Colony for a full v1.0 release. Although we don’t have an exact release date yet, we can say that you all will be able to play all the new content very soon! 

Something that we do want to be transparent about is that upon v1.0 release, the price of that game will be increasing very slightly. We wanted to have a lower price point during Early Access as a “thank you” for players willing to trust us to complete this game. Since release back in April, the game’s content has grown so much and we appreciate all of you that have backed us with your support and feedback.

Lastly, as a bit of a gift from us to you, we wanted to share the new Arena that you all will be able to play very soon! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/062b87f02152d478d33d9d684d048888fe375e34.jpg
CRYSTAL CAVE (In development)

Thank you all for a great 2024! See you in 2025!

notes.title: Villager Update!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here!

We've got an awesome new update that focuses on the villagers! 
Take a peak at all the new things in this update!


EA v0.5 Patch Notes


New Structure - Assembly

 Build the Assembly and use it to summon all your villagers (more on them later) to quickly gather their gifts.


New Structure - Watchtower

 Watchtower brings a new companion (see below) to help in the Arenas and will give you +10% AOE when built!


New Companion - Captain Watchington & Crew! 

 This new team of companions will set up ballistae around an Arena and target nearby  enemies. Trick your enemies, lure them to the ballistae, and let the crew annihilate them!  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/bbb192f976a2d186ba902202c9ac88f234887353.png
Villager Changes:

 We have updated the villagers to no longer be recolors of Tato’s model! 
 When villagers are spawned in after building a villager home, or returning from a run on an existing villager home, the villager will have a randomized appearance. As of now, there are roughly 270,000 variations of villagers that can spawn. (And that doesn’t even include how big/small they can be) The odds of having 2 villagers exactly the same is extremely rare! Keep a lookout for all the cute (or weird) villagers you can have!
 Villagers will always have a gift for the player when returning from a run.


General Changes:

 Settings menu has been updated so that you can change your settings then apply them to make the changes.
 Companion outlines can now be changed in the settings menu.

notes.title: v0.1.4 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Nathan the Game Dev here! 

v0.1.4 is live! We've been listening to feedback and are happy to share a new Arena, Hallow Haven, and that we've created new enemy variations.

Also a highly requested feature: Steam Cloud Saves! Woohoo!

If you've been enjoying the game, don't forget to leave us a review. We'd really appreciate it!

Early Access v0.1.4 Patch Notes

Gameplay Changes:


 Added a new Arena - Hallowed Haven!
 Added the ability to reroll & cast out (aka banish) skills upon leveling up.
 Acorn Trees can now drop additional rerolls.
 Reroll and cast out(aka banish) added to Gym.
 Made adjustments to the following stat boosts: Experience, Cooldown, Knockback, and Pickup Gym increases.
 Roxy’s Banishing Blow has gained projectiles.
 After a completion of the normal amount of waves is completed in Endless mode, the enemies become stronger.
 Balanced the amount of Flower Coins given at the end of a night, with a higher emphasis on completing a run.
 Added a “True Survival Bonus” at the end of a run.
 Trees in the Dark Forest become transparent when approaching.
 Adjustment made to Wave Total and Spawns in Happy Lil’ Forest.


Enemy and Boss Changes:


 New Venus Fly Trap Boss!
 Frog Boss now charges at the player.
 Charging and Projectile enemy types added.


Bugs Squashed:


 Fixed Treasure Box collision. Player no longer gets stuck after opening the chest.
 Crescent Moon, Eclipse, and Blood Moon achievements have been fixed and can be unlocked.
 Fixed glitch where the Toxic skill wasn't affected by the Player’s Area stat.
 Fixed glitch where refunding Pick Up Radius permanent boost from Gym could result in an abnormally small pick up radius.


UI and Miscellaneous:


 Steam Cloud Saving has been enabled.
 Custom cursor has been added to Arenas.
 Stat Menu has been updated.

notes.title: Demo v1.4! Big changes for our little bugs!
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone! 

We have updated our demo! This update changes a core gameplay feature. Please take a look at the patch notes below.



Demo 1.4 Patch Notes (3-21-24):

Combat Arenas
We have changed where the player fights for the combat portion of the game. Players will no longer fight in the colony they build, but in a completely different area that we are calling Arenas. 

As we watched gamers play our demo, from the initial upload to the most recent update for Steam Next Fest, we began to realize that players did not want to build their colony since they felt that if they built too much, they were hindering their own survival. Even after giving incentives to build (extra Flower Coins, stat boost, etc.) it just became more clear based on what we watched and feedback we received that we needed to pivot. We feel that creating Arenas for combat solves this issue, and gives us creativity to create fun and unique Arenas further down the road. 

The demo has 1 arena available and we are planning on having more unique arenas ready to play in the full version of the game. 

Overall, the core game loop remains the same: playing in the combat phase gives resources to build the colony and growing your colony helps you grow your stats.

Please note that due to this change, some features did get cut, such as the traps. We do have plans to work those back into the game, but in a different way.



Companions
We have added a Companion System to the game! When certain Structures are built in your colony, there will be an NPC that will be able to join you in combat!

As of now, we have 3 Companions, (all of which use generic villager models for now), but there are plans to add more, and give them their unique 3D models!




Clean Up
We've introduced a new feature called 'Clean Up' to further enrich the colony building experience. When you first start your colony, it will be a mess. To create room to build objects in your colony, you’ll have to clear a spot for it. Cleaning up items will grant you extra flower coins, and if you have villagers in your colony, they will pitch in to assist!

The items to clean up are spawned procedurally, so your colony will be unique from all the others to give each player a slightly different experience!



Other Stuff
We have made general changes here and that you might spot if you are returning to the demo. 

We have added an opening sequence, spread out and simplified our tutorials, made enemy stat changes, changed the way some skills/buildings can unlock (Please note that even though the library will give the secret to unlock something, not everything will be able to be unlocked in the demo), made tons of UI changes, and so much more! 

As always, feel free to share your thoughts in the feedback forum or in our Discord server!

notes.title: Demo v1.3 Update! (02-02-2024)
notes.notes:
Hey there! 

We are LIVE with a new demo update, just in time for Steam Next Fest! (Wooo!)

Let's go over some changes to the demo.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43948295/1fe0e29556a1d18a363016d7225b800ed5ae7d8f.png

Demo 1.3 Patch Notes:
Combat and Enemy Changes


 Dash Skills
Last update, we changed how the dash worked. This update, we have Dash Skills! These skills trigger when the player dashes.

 Cut Currency: Gold Coin
We tried to make the Gold Coins work, which played a bigger part in the original game's design, but it ended up confusing players. "Idk what the coins are for..." was a statement we heard a lot in let's play videos. We purged them from existence, leaving the Flower Coins as the only currency. 

 Enemies and Bosses
We have adjusted the speed and health of many enemies, as well as when they spawn. Speaking of spawning, the game will now pick between 2 different bosses every night, who now have a set HP amount, rather than scaling with the player, as it was before. As always, to win a night, you MUST defeat the boss, even if it means going into extra waves.

 TREASURE!
When you defeat a miniboss or boss, a treasure chest will drop! Now, when you get near it you will see a fun little animation with the skill(s) that get leveled up from the chest. I say skills with the "(s)" because there is now a chance that it'll be a rare chest and upgrade multiple skills that you have!



Colony Changes


 Colony Enrichment
Players can now place objects around their colony to increase a colony's enrichment. When the enrichment level is increased, the player will gain a permanent stat boost based on that level.

 Building Stat Boost
In addition to Colony Enrichment, structures will also give a stat boost to the player as long as it is built in the colony.

 Building Blueprint Cost
Before, when the player unlocked a blueprint after a night, it required Flower Coins to fully unlock before building the object. We have gotten rid of this. As soon as you unlock it through gameplay, you can build it the next day, free of charge. :) We hope this also shortens the early portion of the game and gets you into the thick of it much quicker!

 New Building: Library
Players can now unlock a library! The Library will let you gain better insight into how to unlock skills and other buildings! (NOTE: Not all skills and buildings are included in the demo and will not unlock even after meeting the requirements for unlock.) Here, you can also touch up on anything you might need to re-learn.

 Cut Building: Bank
Due to the cutting of the gold coin, the Bank no longer served a purpose. However, we are exploring ways to bring it back in some other way and give it a new purpose. But for now, the safe is locked in... another safe?



That's it for now! Everyone enjoy Steam Next Fest! Don't forget to Wishlist, tell your friends to Wishlist, and tell your pets to Wishlist! Talk to you soon!

- Wooshido Dev Team
